top_15.authors: Edmond Awad; Sohan Dsouza; Richard Kim; Jonathan Schulz; Joseph Henrich; Azim Shariff; Jean-François Bonnefon; Iyad Rahwan
top_15.A2_rationale: The original Moral Machine experiment. Not grounded in a specific moral psychology theory but creates a novel empirical paradigm for studying moral preferences in trolley-type dilemmas at global scale.
top_15.A6_rationale: 40 million decisions from 2.3M+ people in 233 countries. Published in Nature. Demonstrates universal and culturally variable preferences. The gold standard for trolley-type moral preferences.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 40 million decisions from 2.3M+ people across 233 countries in 10 languages. 9 moral dimensions measured.

top_15.file: 2024-Takemoto-The moral machine experiment on large language.md
top_15.short_title: The moral machine experiment on large language
top_15.A2_rationale: Applies the Moral Machine methodology to LLMs with 50,000 generated scenarios across 6 moral dimensions. Theory-derived from established experimental paradigm.
top_15.A6_rationale: Uses established Moral Machine methodology with published human baselines from 40M+ decisions. Published in Royal Society Open Science. Conjoint analysis framework.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 50,000 generated moral machine scenarios across 6 primary dimensions (species, social value, gender, age, fitness, utilitarianism) + 3 secondary dimensions

top_15.authors: Edmond Awad; Sohan Dsouza; Jean-François Bonnefon; Azim Shariff; Iyad Rahwan
top_15.A2_rationale: Overview/perspective paper on the Moral Machine platform. Describes methodology and discusses implications. Same underlying paradigm as the Nature paper.
top_15.A6_rationale: CACM overview of the validated Moral Machine platform. Discusses methodological critiques and responses. Published in Communications of the ACM.
top_15.B2_size_notes: Describes the same 40M-decision Moral Machine platform from the Nature paper

top_15.authors: Joe Hoover; Gwenyth Portillo-Wightman; Leigh Yeh; Shreya Havaldar; Aida Mostafazadeh Davani; Ying Lin; Brendan Kennedy; Mohammad Atari; Zahra Kamel; Madelyn Mendlen; Gabriela Moreno; Christina Park; Tingyee E. Chang; Jenna Chin; Christian Leong; Jun Yen Leung; Arineh Mirinjian; Morteza Dehghani
top_15.A2_rationale: The foundational MFT annotated corpus. 35k tweets annotated for 10 moral sentiment categories (5 foundations x virtue/vice). Theory-derived annotation scheme with trained annotators.
top_15.A6_rationale: 35,108 tweets, 13 trained annotators with psychological/demographic metadata. Baseline classification results. Seminal dataset that spawned many follow-up works. Published in SPPS.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 35,108 tweets from 7 domains (BLM, ALM, Baltimore protests, 2016 election, hate speech, Hurricane Sandy, MeToo) annotated for 10 moral sentiment categories

top_15.file: 2022-Fraser-Does Moral Code Have a Moral Code.md
top_15.short_title: Does Moral Code Have a Moral Code?
top_15.authors: Kathleen C. Fraser; Kiritchenko, Svetlana; Balkir, Esma
top_15.A2_rationale: Probes Delphi model with MFQ/Schweder's Big Three Ethics + deontology/utilitarianism measures. Adapts validated instruments to Delphi's input/output format.
top_15.A4_source_instrument: MFQ + Schweder's Big Three + Oxford Utilitarianism Scale (adapted)
top_15.A6_rationale: Uses established instruments adapted for Delphi's three-class output format. Compares to published demographic patterns. Limited by Delphi's constrained output space.
top_15.B2_size_notes: Adapted versions of MFQ, Schweder's ethics measure, and Oxford Utilitarianism Scale, plus sacrificial dilemmas. Exact item count not specified.
top_15.D5_source_publication: MFQ + Schweder's Big Three + Oxford Utilitarianism Scale (adapted)

top_15.short_title: Moral Foundations of Large Language Models
top_15.authors: Marwa Abdulhai; Gregory Serapio-García; Clement Crepy; Daria Valter; John Canny; Natasha Jaques
top_15.A2_rationale: Directly administers the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (MFQ-30), a validated instrument from MFT, with standard scoring across 5 foundations.
top_15.A6_rationale: MFQ-30 is extensively validated. Paper compares LLM scores to published human population data across political affiliations and societies. Includes consistency analysis and downstream behavioral task.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 30-item MFQ plus consistency probes across multiple conversational contexts, plus downstream donation benchmark

top_15.short_title: Differences in Moral Foundations of LLMs
top_15.A2_rationale: Directly administers the Moral Foundations Vignettes (MFV; Clifford et al. 2015) -- 116 moral vignettes on a Likert scale -- to 20+ frontier LLMs. Compares to nationally representative human sample.
top_15.A6_rationale: Uses validated MFV instrument with published nationally representative US human baseline from Clifford et al. Descriptive statistical analysis including PCA of moral foundations.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 116 moral vignettes from Clifford et al. 2015, rated on 0-4 severity scale by 20+ LLMs from 6 providers
top_15.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude-3 Opus, DeepSeek, GPT-3.5, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok, Llama-3, o3-mini

top_15.authors: Sorensen, Taylor; Jiang, Liwei; Hwang, Jena; Levine, Sydney; Pyatkin, Valentina; West, Peter; Dziri, Nouha; Lu, Ximing; Rao, Kavel; Bhagavatula, Chandra; Sap, Maarten; Tasioulas, John; Choi, Yejin
top_15.A2_rationale: Value pluralism framework inspired by philosophical value pluralism, not a specific moral psychology theory. GPT-4 generates values, rights, and duties for 31k situations.
top_15.A6_rationale: 218k values from GPT-4, rated 91% high-quality by annotators. Large-scale human study with diverse demographics. Transfers to other philosophical frameworks. Published at AAAI 2024.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 218k contextualized values/rights/duties connected to 31k human-written situations. Model generates, explains, and assesses relevance/valence of values.

top_15.file: 2026-Huang-Knowing But Not Doing Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in.md
top_15.short_title: Knowing But Not Doing: Convergent Morality and Divergent Action in LLMs (ValAct-15k)
top_15.A2_rationale: Directly uses PVQ-40 (validated Schwartz instrument) alongside VALACT-15K scenario-based benchmark grounded in Schwartz's 10 basic values. Dual-method design (questionnaire + scenario) enables knowledge-action gap analysis.
top_15.A6_rationale: PVQ-40 is a well-validated instrument. VALACT-15K systematically covers 10 Schwartz values across 5 domains. Human participants (n=55) provide baseline. Knowledge-action gap analysis is methodologically sophisticated. Cross-cultural comparison (US vs Chinese LLMs).

top_15.file: 2025-Shen-ValueCompass A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment.md
top_15.short_title: ValueCompass: A Framework for Measuring Contextual Value Alignment
top_15.A2_rationale: Adapts SVS and PVQ into scenario-based Value Form instrument. Uses Schwartz's 56 values across 10 types but contextualizes them into 4 real-world scenarios. Robust prompting with 8 variants per question. Not a direct administration of standard instruments.
top_15.A6_rationale: Grounded in Schwartz's 56 values with SVS/PVQ-derived items. 112 humans from 7 countries across 4 scenarios. Multiple alignment metrics (rate, distance, ranking). Cross-country and cross-scenario analysis. Robust 8-variant prompting reduces noise.

top_15.authors: Wu, Ping; Shen, Guobin; Zhao, Dongcheng; Wang, Yuwei; Dong, Yiting; Shi, Yu; Lu, Enmeng; Zhao, Feifei; Zeng, Yi
top_15.A2_rationale: Novel Chinese value framework based on core socialist values (3 dimensions, 12 core values, 50 derived values). References MFT but deliberately rejects it as Western-centric.
top_15.A4_source_instrument: None (novel Chinese value framework, adapted from Social Chemistry 101 and MIC)
top_15.A6_rationale: 250k value rules with human annotation. 87.5% alignment with Chinese annotators. Validated against 17 LLMs. Novel framework grounded in Chinese political/cultural context.
top_15.B2_size_notes: 250k+ value rules, 400k+ rule-based moral dilemma scenarios. 10,998 evaluated across 17 LLMs.
top_15.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, GPT-4o, Llama-3, Qwen
top_15.D5_source_publication: None (novel Chinese value framework, adapted from Social Chemistry 101 and MIC)

top_15.file: 2025-Zhu-TrolleyBench - Evaluating Emergent Moral Reasoning and Consistency in.md
top_15.short_title: TrolleyBench -- Evaluating Emergent Moral Reasoning and Consistency in LLMs
top_15.A2_rationale: Theory-inspired benchmark drawing on Kohlberg, Schwartz, and MFT literature. Focuses on consistency metrics (ECI, entropy-based Inconsistency Score) rather than theory operationalization.
top_15.A6_rationale: Novel consistency metrics (ECI, Inconsistency Score) are interesting but not validated. Human baselines collected but limited. No convergent/discriminant validity.
top_15.B2_size_notes: Approximately 50 dilemmas with clarifying and contradictory follow-ups, designed for consistency evaluation

top_15.authors: Baixiang Huang; Zhen Tan; Haoran Wang; Zijie Liu; Dawei Li; Ali Payani; Huan Liu; Tianlong Chen; Kai Shu
top_15.A2_rationale: BEHAVIORBENCH is grounded in Rest's Four Component Model, Kohlberg's stages, MFT, and normative ethics. Three-tier structure maps to moral psychology theory progression.

top_15.A6_rationale: Three-tier theoretical grounding (moral sensitivity, judgment, agency). Uses established datasets. Tests behavior editing across frontier LLMs. Novel paradigm but composite benchmark.
top_15.B2_size_notes: Composite from Social Chemistry 101, Low/High-Ambiguity MoralChoice, ETHICS, Jiminy Cricket datasets across 3 tiers
top_15.D3_llms_evaluated: Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, GPT-4o, Gemini, Grok, Llama-2, Llama-3, Mistral, Qwen, o1, o3
top_15.D5_source_publication: Social Chemistry 101, MoralChoice, ETHICS, Jiminy Cricket (composite)

top_15.file: 2025-Jiang-EMNLP Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling.md
top_15.short_title: EMNLP (Educator-role Moral and Normative LLMs Profiling)
top_15.A2_rationale: Extends existing personality scales (HEXACO, OUS/GGB) and constructs 88 teacher-specific moral dilemmas grounded in Kohlberg's stages. Uses adapted instruments rather than validated originals directly, but substantial instrument development work.
top_15.A6_rationale: Compares LLM personality profiles with human teachers but construct validity for the 88 dilemmas is not formally validated with psychometric analysis. Kohlberg staging is conceptual rather than rigorously operationalized with DIT-2 or similar.
